title: FERC Compliance Directives — Docket P-2546-000: Letter to WEC Energy Group providing comments on the 06/17/2026 Dam Safety Inspection, 2024 and 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Reports, etc. for the Sandstone Rapids Hydroelectric Project under P-2546.
text:
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
Office of Energy Projects
Division of Dam Safety and Inspections
Chicago Regional Office
In reply refer to: P-2546
July 2, 2026
VIA ELECTRONIC MAIL
Mr. Todd Jastremski, Manager
Asset Manager Hydro Operations
WEC Energy Group c/o We Energies
Todd.Jastremski@we-energies.com
RE: Sandstone Rapids Hydroelectric Project (FERC No. 2546)
▪ 2026 FERC Dam Safety Inspection – Post-Inspection Letter
▪ 2024 & 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Reports
▪ January 29, 2026 – Emergency Action Plan Update
Dear Mr. Jastremski:
The annual Dam Safety Inspection of the Sandstone Rapids Hydroelectric Project,
FERC No. 2546 was conducted by Mr. Adam Christy on June 17, 2026. All project
structures were inspected, and no deficiencies were observed that would require
immediate remedial action.
Be advised that we may provide you with additional comments that develop
because of our preparation of the dam safety inspection report. Thank you for the
assistance provided by your staff during the inspection.
The 2024 and 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Reports (DSSMRs)
were received with July 18, 2025 and January 29, 2026 submittals, respectively. The
DSSMRs indicate that based on visual inspections, observations, and instrumentation
evaluation, the project is performing adequately and there are no conditions requiring
immediate attention. We have the following comments regarding the 2026 DSI and 2024
and 2025 DSSMRs:
1. It was discussed during the inspection that trees on the downstream left abutment
would be removed to allow for improved visibility for monitoring. The status of the
tree clearing should be provided in the next DSSMR submittal.
2. The annual status report on the outstanding dam safety-related recommendations
identified in the 2025 Part 12D Report was provided in Appendix D of the 2025

DSSMR. The submittal satisfies the requirement of 18 C.F.R., Part 12, Subpart D,
§ 12.41 (a)(2).
The DSSMRs include a statement from the Chief Dam Safety Engineer that the
dam is safe for continued operation. Our review finds the 2024 and 2025 DSSMRs fulfill
the requirements in Chapter 14 – Appendix K of our Engineering Guidelines. The 2026
DSSMR is due by April 1, 2027.
The EAP update satisfactorily fulfils the reviewing and updating requirements of
18 C.F.R., Part 12, Subpart C § 12.24 and the FERC’s Engineering Guidelines. The next
Annual EAP Update is due by December 31, 2026.
File your submittal using the Commission’s eFiling system at
https://www.ferc.gov/ferc-online/overview. When eFiling, select Hydro: Dam Safety and
Chicago Regional Office from the eFiling menu. The cover page of the filing must
indicate that the material was eFiled. For assistance with eFiling, contact FERC Online
Support at FERCOnlineSupport@ferc.gov, (866) 208-3676 (toll free), or (202) 502-8659
(TTY).
You may contact Mr. Adam Christy at (312) 596-4462 (adam.christy@ferc.gov)
or me at (312) 596-4430, if you have any questions regarding this letter.
Sincerely,
Marilyn Sabido, P.E.
Regional Engineer
